name: Acme Employee Handbook 2026
content: Acme is a remote-first company. Standard PTO is 25 days plus public holidays. Health coverage starts on day one. All-hands is the first Monday of each month.

name: Q1 2026 Security Review (Restricted)
content: Executive summary: One S3 bucket misconfiguration; remediated. Two IAM key rotations. Pen-test findings: medium-severity SSRF in the legacy proxy, patched. Recommendation: adopt least-privilege defaults in CDK constructs going forward.

name: Website Brand Guide
content: The website uses the primary brand blue #1E40AF for CTAs and links. Headings use Inter Bold 700. Body uses Inter Regular 400 at 16px / 1.5 line-height.
